name: How much does a home remodel cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a home remodel cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Home remodel costs in the Bay Area depend on the project's size, materials chosen, and scope of work. Kitchen remodels can range from $25,000 to over $100,000, while bathroom remodels typically fall between $15,000 and $50,000. Room additions or whole-house remodels can be substantially more. These are estimates, and exact costs require a detailed assessment. City Dweller, LLC provides transparent, detailed estimates after an initial consultation to help you budget effectively for your specific project.
